_readme: The answer key. See README.md. 'pages' lists the slugs one numbered finding must name for the defect to score. 'superseded_by' is context for the human reader and is not scored.

defects.why: One says the vector index rebuilds hourly, the other says nightly.
One budgets against a 128,000-token window, the other states a 32,768-token ceiling.
One says embeddings are computed at write time, the other says lazily on first read.
Two pages for retrying a failed tool call, under different titles.
Two pages for splitting a document at topic boundaries, under different titles.
Two pages for the wall-clock bound on one run, under different titles.
Catering and room booking. RULES.md excludes social events and catering.
Volunteer day sign-up and transport. RULES.md excludes volunteer days.
Benefits enrollment. RULES.md excludes employee benefits administration.
